scope: Internal 79-entry component-table initialization and refresh calculations. This is not a complete root model, feature-query implementation, or original external ABI.

static_bindings.role: initialize_layout; starts with 79 ones and applies ordered writes
refresh_layout; independently regenerates the table using additional root inputs
Original feature query; observed results are explicit candidate inputs, not a reconstructed implementation
Virtual dimension setter: unchanged dimension returns without reset; changed dimension is stored before root cleanup and reinitialization

input_contract.dimension: Exact signed integer; 2 and 3 branches are distinct, without normalization.
input_contract.scalars: Twenty root scalar fields retain offset-based names until their domain meanings are established.
input_contract.queries: Explicit enabled and post-call width values for IDs 24, 49, 53, 29, 54, 55 and 46. A width can retain the previous local accumulator value.
input_contract.arithmetic: Checked signed-int32 intermediates. Overflow throws; equivalence to native overflow or invalid allocation behavior is not claimed.

evaluation.candidate_history: Three source files and one replay executable were archived before both new captures. Historical report enforces current identity; regression mode reports current identity separately while always verifying archived hashes.
evaluation.query_coverage: ID24 enabled only; ID49 both enabled and disabled; IDs53/29/54/55/46 disabled only. Observed output widths are zero.

established_transition_behavior: Changing the dimension destroys current objects through root cleanup before initialization; it does not convert an existing mesh.
Same-dimension calls preserve the captured root and object subset.
The first recognized header controls the import; later recognized headers in that import are ignored in the observed sequences.
The parser also applies the complementary dimension to an existing linked root even when alternate routing is disabled.
Existing-model refresh is a different path: regenerate the table, visit objects whose type is not 7, and resize their arrays.
Direct-array resize helpers use realloc and contain no explicit initialization of newly grown tails. Zero-filled tails must not be inferred.
limitations: This component checkpoint does not itself integrate root reset. Later selected importer integration is recorded in analysis/dimension-import-contract.json.
Feature queries can mutate root/global state and depend on materials. Passing observed query results does not reproduce those effects.
The probe attaches after process startup. Initialization calls here occur during dimension resets, not initial process construction.
Root snapshots cover selected fields and object summaries, not every byte, mesh array or scientific invariant.
No arbitrary-dimension, extreme arithmetic, nonzero query-width, allocation-failure or complete material-state equivalence is established.
Preserving object resize, complete destruction, unit/global persistence and scientific finalization remain separate recovery work.
next_action: Recover and implement root dimension reset and linked-root behavior with original model comparisons. Recover preserving array resize and feature-query dependencies before integrating GEOTYP/STNOUT-driven refresh.
